name: Explore an investigation profile
description: Selecting a PSI investigation updates its aggregate profile.
steps: Review its row count, median index, oxygen range and fuel
expected: PSI-69 shows 274 rows, median supplied index 1.78 and oxygen range 12–34%.

name: Filter and export a summary
description: Filters narrow the catalogue and export the matching summary.
expected: The catalogue narrows to FLEX and FLEX-2 and downloads NASA_investigation_summary.csv.

name: Review data quality on mobile
description: Data-quality warnings remain readable on a mobile viewport.
steps: Review oxygen and pressure validation cards
expected: Two oxygen values above 100% and 170 pressure values above 100 psi are displayed.

name: Generate an SI research brief
description: The SI page produces an evidence-grounded local research brief.
expected: A brief appears and states the supplied index is undocumented and not a validated safety score.
